title: onboard-odyssey-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard Odyssey-13B v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, performance profiles, and automated release notes integration. Motivation: Odyssey-13B is a community-released 13B dense transformer that shows strong quality/cost tradeoffs for retrieval-augmented generation workflows. This PR: (1) Adds canonical metadata.yaml for model identity, supported weight formats, quantization compatibility and recommended runtime knobs; (2) Adds perf_profiles.json with latency/throughput matrices measured across representative shard/instance types and sequence lengths; (3) Extends changelog automation so new model registry entries automatically generate a draft release note stanza; (4) Adds integration tests and a small example for SDK usage. Checklist: - [x] metadata schema validated against registry spec - [x] perf profiles generated from perf-lab runs and reviewed by infra - [x] changelog generator updated to include model_registry entries - [x] unit + integration tests added - [x] docs snippet included in model onboarding guide Notes: perf numbers were measured on the perf-canary infra (A100-40GB and T4 pools) using the standard 8/16/32 token prompt matrix. Quantized configurations (int8/4bit) are labeled with expected quality impact in the metadata. Related: ENG-4521 tracks follow-up work to add multi-GPU sharding recipes for very long-context serving.
commits: Fix: minor schema key typos after validator run
perf_profile_summary: Odyssey-13B v1.0 perf summary: A100-40GB single-GPU (fp16) baseline latency 75ms per token (seq_len=8 warm), sustained throughput 55 tokens/s for batch=4; T4 int8 quantized baseline latency 190ms per token (seq_len=32), throughput 14 tokens/s. Recommended runtime flavor: fp16 for latency-sensitive paths, int8 for cost-sensitive bulk embedding/generation flows. KV cache warmup observed at ~6 tokens. Profiles include memory headroom and expected token cost estimates.
changelog_update: Adds automatic model registry stanza to release notes generator. New entries create: - model name, version, short description, perf highlights, link to onboarding docs. Generator attaches the stanza to the 'Model Registry' section and outputs a draft in CHANGELOG/drafts for product review. The script includes a --dry-run and CI check to ensure every merged model PR produces a draft changelog entry.
